title: Thai Crispy Sweet Potato Fritters
description: Crispy on the outside, sweet and fluffy on the inside, these Thai-inspired sweet potato fritters are a delicious snack or side dish.
instructions: 1. In a large bowl, combine grated sweet potatoes, flour, and salt. Mix well.
2. Divide the mixture into 8 equal parts and shape each part into a ball.
3. Flatten each ball slightly into a disk shape.
4. Heat about 1/2 inch of vegetable oil in a large non-stick skillet over medium-high heat.
5. When the oil is hot, add 4 fritters to the skillet (do not overcrowd).
6. Cook the fritters for about 3-4 minutes on each side, or until they are golden brown and crispy.
7. Remove the fritters from the oil and place them on a paper towel-lined plate to drain excess oil.
8. Repeat the cooking process with the remaining 4 fritters.
9. Serve the fritters hot with tangy mayonnaise and crispy fried onions on top.
10. Garnish with additional crispy fried onions and a sprinkle of salt, if desired.
